tagline: Browse the looks your Agent has worn and switch their avatar in one click, or go back to the original.
summary: Outfits keeps a history of the avatar pictures (called looks) your Agent has worn and lets you switch between them. Click the avatar in the Nova chat to open the list, choose a look, or return to the Base avatar. It does not draw pictures by itself: new looks come from your Agent, who can make them with ComfyUI and save them here.
whatYouGet: No new screen: click your Agent's avatar in the Nova chat and an Outfits window opens.
Every saved look in one grid, newest first, with the original Base avatar always one click away.
A short note in the Agent's live chat when the look changes.
Four ready-made ComfyUI picture recipes your Agent can use to make new looks.
privacy: Looks are stored on this PC with the rest of your Leaf data. Outfits sends nothing anywhere; new pictures are made by your own ComfyUI.

requirements.label: Nova
requirements.detail: The Outfits picker lives on the avatar in the Nova chat.

requirements.label: ComfyUI (to make new looks)
requirements.detail: Optional. Only needed if you want your Agent to generate new outfit pictures.

setup.title: Have Nova installed
setup.body: Outfits adds its picker to the avatar in the Nova chat, so Nova needs to be installed.

setup.title: Open the picker
setup.body: In a Nova chat, hover your Agent's avatar: a T-shirt icon appears. Click it to open the Outfits window.

setup.title: Choose a look
setup.body: Click any picture to wear it. Click Base to go back to the original avatar. The tick shows what is worn now.

setup.title: Make new looks (optional)
setup.body: Install the ComfyUI extension, then ask your Agent to create an outfit. The new look is saved in the history.

useCases.title: Change the look for the day
useCases.story: You open the chat in the morning and fancy something different. Pick a look from the history yourself, or ask your Agent to choose one.
useCases.try: Nova, put on a different outfit from your history for today.

useCases.title: Create a brand new look
useCases.story: Going out on a rainy evening? Ask your Agent to design a matching outfit. It is made with ComfyUI and saved so you can wear it again later.

useCases.title: Return to the original
useCases.story: Tired of experiments? Open the picker and click Base to get the original avatar back. Your history stays untouched.

limitations: It does not generate pictures on its own: new looks need your Agent and the ComfyUI extension.
Each Agent has their own wardrobe; you cannot wear another Agent's look.
Looks flagged NSFW stay hidden in the picker until you click Show NSFW.
Removing Outfits removes the picker, but your history and the current avatar are kept and come back if you reinstall.

troubleshooting.symptom: I cannot find the Outfits picker
troubleshooting.fix: Open a Nova chat and hover over your Agent's avatar, then click it. If nothing happens, check that Nova and Outfits are both installed and enabled.

troubleshooting.symptom: A look I made is not in the grid
troubleshooting.fix: Looks flagged NSFW are hidden by default. A Show NSFW button appears above the grid when there are some; click it to reveal them.

troubleshooting.symptom: My Agent cannot make new looks
troubleshooting.fix: New pictures need the ComfyUI extension installed and working. Install it, then ask again.

agent.whenToSuggest: When the user wants to see, change or save an Agent's avatar outfit, go back to the original avatar, or have the Agent create a new look.
